title: Quantum Fidelity on Krein and S-spaces
summary: The notion of fidelity for quantum states is a measure of how much two states overlap. In the matrix formalism of quantum mechanics, states are represented by density operators, i.e., positive semi-definite matrices with trace equal to 1 in a complex Euclidean space $M_n(\mathbb{C})$. Felipe-Sosa and Felipe (2022) introduced the notion of quantum states on certain Krein spaces with indefinite metric induced by a fundamental symmetry $J$, calling these $J$-states.
